name: Confusion Effect
slug: A spell effect that leaves its victim confused and unable to act meaningfully.
description: A confusion effect caused by a spell that disrupts a creature's ability to think and act coherently.

log.summary: Gerk was affected by a confusion spell after failing a Wisdom saving throw. The effect left him incoherent and unable to move or take meaningful actions.
notes: Gerk is affected by a confusion spell following his failed Wisdom saving throw.
The effect leaves Gerk incoherent and unable to move or take meaningful actions.

log.summary: The confusion effect continues to afflict Gerk aboard the invisible boat even after Sylan physically wrangles him in an attempt to break it. Gerk fails a wisdom save with a natural one during the struggle, remaining disoriented enough to grab back at unseen hands and later try to swing Sylan.
notes: Still afflicts Gerk despite Sylan's physical attempts to shake him out of it.
Gerk fails a wisdom save with a natural 1 during the attempt.
